project_summary: nTrade is a quantitative trading platform SDK for Indian markets (NSE/BSE/MCX). It provides an instrument-centric API where every market entity (Equity, Future, Option, Index, Commodity) owns its own state (quote, depth, history, stream) and broker transport is hidden behind a BrokerAdapter. Currently integrated with Dhan via Dhan-Tradehull. Architecture: event-driven kernel with engine pipeline (Market→Candle→Indicator→Strategy→Risk→Portfolio), typed EventBus, execution router supporting live/paper/replay modes. 75 source files, 7269 LOC, 40 test files, 361 passing tests.

flows.market_data: BrokerAdapter.get_quote() → Quote (frozen) → Instrument.apply_quote() → QuoteUpdatedEvent → EventBus → MarketEngine → CandleEngine → IndicatorEngine → StrategyEngine
flows.order_lifecycle: Instrument.order.buy() → OrderFacade → Order → BrokerAdapter.place_order() → OrderPlacedEvent → EventBus → OrderEngine → RiskEngine → BrokerExecution → FillEvent → PortfolioEngine
flows.live_streaming: BrokerAdapter.subscribe() → LiveStream → tick ingestion → Instrument._quote update → TickEvent/QuoteEvent → EventBus → engines → strategy callbacks
flows.position_sync: PositionSyncEngine pulls broker.get_positions()/get_balance() → reconciles into kernel Portfolio → raises on failure (never silently zeros)
flows.replay: EventStore → timestamped events → ReplayClock.setTime() → EventBus.publish() → identical engine pipeline as live (zero parity)

components.ntrade/brokers/: Broker adapter layer: BrokerAdapter (abstract), DhanBroker (Dhan-Tradehull wrapper, 1095 LOC), PaperBroker (deterministic offline), capabilities (dynamic broker-specific extensions via BrokerExtensionFacade)
components.ntrade/domain/instruments/: Instrument hierarchy: Instrument (ABC) → Equity, Index, ETF, Currency, Commodity, Bond, Crypto, Spot, Future, Option, SyntheticInstrument. Each owns quote, depth, history, stream, indicators, broker wiring
components.ntrade/domain/market/: Market value objects: Quote (frozen), Tick (frozen), MarketDepth (frozen), HistoricalSeries (DataFrame wrapper with cache/fetch/resample), LiveStream (subscription lifecycle + callbacks)
components.ntrade/domain/orders/: Order model: Order (mutable dataclass), OrderFacade (fluent API: instrument.order.buy()), OrderSide/OrderType/TradeType/OrderStatus enums
components.ntrade/kernel/: Core runtime: TradingKernel (engine stack coordinator), EventBus (typed pub/sub), TradingClock (Live/Replay), TradingContext, ResilientKernel (crash recovery + EventStore rebuild)
components.ntrade/engines/: Engine pipeline: MarketEngine, CandleEngine, IndicatorEngine, StrategyEngine, RiskEngine, PortfolioEngine, PositionSyncEngine, OrderEngine
components.ntrade/execution/: Execution layer: ExecutionRouter (multi-target), BrokerExecution (live), SimulatedExecution (paper), costs module
components.ntrade/facade.py: Public entry point: Market class — wraps BrokerRegistry + InstrumentFactory. m.equity('TCS'), m.index('NIFTY'), m.portfolio(), m.account()
components.ntrade/factories.py: InstrumentFactory — creates all instrument types with SymbolMaster flyweight cache. OptionFactory for synthetic analytics
components.ntrade/registry.py: SymbolMaster (flyweight: shared instrument instances), BrokerRegistry (name → factory: dhan, paper)
components.ntrade/events/: Typed event hierarchy: Event (base), QuoteUpdatedEvent, TickEvent, OrderPlacedEvent, FillEvent, SignalEvent, RiskHaltedEvent, lifecycle events
components.ntrade/sources/: Market data feeds: DhanFeedSource (WebSocket), MarketFeedSource (kernel feed), SyntheticFeedSource (tick simulation)
components.ntrade/runner/: Live runner: wraps TradingKernel + MarketFeedSource, closes audit gaps (position sync, order polling, kill switch)
components.ntrade/backtest/: Backtest simulator: uses TradingKernel in replay mode with SimulatedExecution. Zero parity with live
components.ntrade/replay/: Replay engine: feeds recorded events through EventBus with ReplayClock
